findings.finding: Sumset of supports must be 2 points ⇒ one support size 1, other size 2. Hence α is either ±δ_a (9·2) or ±(δ_a+δ_b) (C(9,2)·2). Total shifty α = 18+72=90. Ensure β exists (singleton or doubleton) giving convolution =1 at two shifts.

Factor α’s generating polynomial A(z)=∑α(i)z^i (deg≤8) must satisfy A(z)·B(z)=z^k(1+z^d). Hence A(z)=±z^r·D(z) where D(z) divides 1+z^d in ℤ[z]. Count all such A(z) with exponents in [0,8]. Avoid assuming only monomials or 2‑term sums.

Count α: A(X)=∑α_iX^i, support ⊂[0,8]. α shifty ⇔ A=X^m·A₀, A₀|X^d+1 for some d. ⇒ A₀=±∏Φ_n, n even, all v₂(n) equal.
